name: InterContinental Nanjing
insider_take: Where ancient imperial grandeur meets cutting-edge luxury in China's former capital
whats_special: This towering landmark sits in the heart of Nanjing's prestigious Gulou District, offering panoramic views of Purple Mountain and the Yangtze River. The hotel's architecture pays homage to the city's 600-year history as China's ancient capital, while its Club InterContinental floors provide exclusive access to some of the city's most spectacular sunset vistas.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 35+ for unobstructed views of the Ming Dynasty city walls and Purple Mountain. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of the Presidential Palace and Xuanwu Lake.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Cantonese restaurant overlooks the historic Drum Tower, and the rooftop bar offers craft cocktails with 360-degree views of six dynasties' worth of architectural heritage. Take the hotel's complimentary shuttle to explore nearby Confucius Temple and the vibrant Qinhuai River district.
pros: Prime location in Nanjing's business and cultural district
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
Full-service spa and comprehensive wellness facilities
